title: Senior Product Manager - Human Robot Interaction

fields.duties:
As a Senior Product Manager - Human Robot Interaction, you will focus on driving the product vision, ensuring seamless execution across the complex hardware/software divide, and translating market demands into user oriented, executable product roadmaps.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Own and maintain the Human Robot Interaction roadmap: scope, sequencing, and feature priorities.
Ensure that our robots and interfaces are intuitive, promoting positive experiences for both developers and end users.
Partner with the UX team to design features to enhance multi-modal communication, including on-robot displays, conversational interfaces, and safety features.
Prioritize predictable behaviors and legible intent improvements using robot motion, gaze, and signaling.
Partner with engineering teams to drive the technical definition for software and hardware HRI systems.
Partner with UX Research to validate and refine human robot interactions before real-world deployments.
Develop interaction frameworks that adapt to user expertise and permission levels, robot task, environmental context, and task requirements.
Define and prioritize use cases based on business impact, feasibility, and customer needs.
Ensure that product development efforts align with real-world economic value for customers.
Synthesize insights from user research, customer meetings, usage data, and sales feedback into a strategy that delivers business objectives and customer benefits.
Work with industrial design, user experience, and engineering teams to conceptualize and implement interactive features.
Define product features/enhancements and communicate requirements to engineering teams via clearly written requirements documents, diagrams, and concise verbal communication.
Support product marketing initiatives, partner relationships, and other opportunities to accelerate the adoption of our products.
fields.requirements:
Strong understanding of interactive or conversational interfaces.
Demonstrated experience with human robot interaction.
Strong analytical skills with experience in performance tracking and data-driven decision-making.
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, enabling translation of technical insights into business impact.
You make decisions in uncertainty, prioritizing velocity over perfection
You prioritize user feedback, promoting and advocating for that voice to internal teams.
NICE TO HAVE:
Experience with autonomous robots or autonomous vehicles.
Experience using simulation tools to improve user experience.
Experience designing UX for end users and developer-facing tools.
Experience working with customers in light and heavy duty industrial environments
Experience with robotics and functional safety standards (ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, ISO 13482, RIA 15.08).
EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE
7+ years of experience in product management
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times
Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen

The Head of Product Management, Hardware leads product management for all of Apptronik's hardware systems, including robots, peripherals, and components. You own the hardware product vision, partnering closely with engineering and manufacturing leadership to develop and execute the hardware roadmap. You build and lead a team of product managers who translate market demands and customer use cases into executable roadmaps. You are accountable for hardware products across their full lifecycle, from concept and new product introduction through production, sustaining, and end-of-life.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Build, lead, and develop the hardware product management team: hire, level, coach, and set the standards for how hardware products are managed.
Partner with engineering leadership developing and maintaining the hardware roadmap: scope, sequencing, and priorities across robots, peripherals, and components.
Own hardware product strategy, assuring engineering deliverables create a coherent portfolio, managing reuse, variants, and configuration strategy
Establish roadmap governance, prioritization frameworks, and metrics discipline across the team, holding product managers accountable to customer-connected, outcome-driven roadmaps.
Drive the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) strategy, balancing unit COGS with field reliability, serviceability, and maintenance costs to maximize customer ROI.
Define and track portfolio-level product and program health metrics, and represent hardware product status in executive reviews.
Drive the full new product introduction (NPI) lifecycle with hardware engineering and operations, from prototype through mass production, owning gate criteria and product go/no-go decisions.
Own the hardware product lifecycle beyond launch: sustaining, continuous improvement, field-issue resolution, spares, and end-of-life planning for a deployed fleet.
Drive make-versus-buy decisions across systems and components, weighing cost, lead time, risk, IP, and supply continuity.
Lead vendor and manufacturing engagement at the product level, working with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and internal manufacturing teams on requirements, feasibility, cost, quality, and supply.
Own product cost: BOM and COGS targets and the sourcing and inventory trade-offs behind them, ensuring competitive unit economics.
Align with software product leadership across the hardware/software divide so systems are defined, sequenced, and integrated coherently.
Partner with safety, quality, and compliance teams to ensure products meet applicable standards and that failure modes and field risks are addressed.
fields.requirements:
Proven track record building and leading product management teams
Deep hardware product and NPI fluency: taking complex hardware from concept through end of life, including design for manufacturability, reliability and validation, and cost/BOM management.
Experience with autonomous robots or similar complex electromechanical systems enabling fluency at the hardware/software co-development boundary.
Hands-on experience working with vendors, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and internal manufacturing teams.
A keen eye for make-versus-buy decisions across systems and components.
Strong analytical skills with metrics discipline for performance tracking and data-driven decision-making.
Excellent verbal and written communication, translating technical insight into business impact for engineering and executive audiences.
EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE
Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in mechanical, electrical, systems, or robotics engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or MBA helpful.
At least 10 years of experience in product management or engineering, including 5+ years leading product managers, with a track record of shipping complex hardware products.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
Ability to spend time on lab and manufacturing floors, and to travel to supplier and manufacturing sites as needed.
Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times.
Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen; hearing and speech to communicate.

Boston Dynamics is looking for an operational Program Manager for Field Operations & Logistics. In this role, you will direct field staffing, human infrastructure, and tactical deployment execution for our mobile humanoid robots across 50+ customer sites as we expand to fleet sizes exceeding 100 Atlas units.
Positioned within the Customer Enablement organization and working in close partnership with the Technical Program Management (TPM) team, you will act as the core operational engine managing our distributed field workforce. Your primary focus will be leading end-to-end personnel operations for Field Service Engineers (FSEs), Field Application Engineers (FAEs), and Robot Pilots/Tele-operators. This includes managing recruitment pipelines, overseeing shift schedules and site assignments, coordinating travel, and monitoring field labor expenses. Furthermore, you will steer on-site operations for high-priority roadshow deliverables to ensure seamless product demonstrations at customer locations.
Responsibilities
Operations & Site Leadership
Operational Oversight:
Guide and equip site operations teams to execute high-impact customer deployments. Maintain accountability across site teams for daily operations, ensuring proper support, robotic assets, and resources are in place for facility setups.
Implementation Accountability:
Deliver on site-specific deployment milestones—such as key performance metrics, facility setup, and data collection targets—across multiple concurrent locations. Serve as the main escalation lead for Site PMs to quickly resolve field issues and keep contractual deliverables on schedule.
Workforce Planning & Team Management
Workforce Management & Logistics:
Lead daily scheduling, shift rotations (such as 8-hour shift coverage for 11-member site pods), leave management, coverage plans, and 8-week site assignment logistics across active roadshow environments.
Hiring & Resource Allocation:
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition to evaluate candidates, run operational interviews, onboard team members, and assign Pilot, FSE, and FAE teams to customer site cohorts aligned with deployment schedules.

You will work with the Hardware Design Managers, Operations Program Managers, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and engineering leads to build comprehensive project plans, which align resources and budgets with project scope, as well as ensuring risks are identified and mitigated. Boston Dynamics is a world leader in mobile robots, tackling some of the toughest robotics challenges. For years, our awe-inspiring
viral videos on YouTube
have shown the world what remarkably capable robots can do. Now we are quickly becoming a recognized leader in automation solutions for industrial applications and warehouse logistics.

Work with functional leads to establish a schedule within the master program schedule and track performance
Coordinate with stakeholders to define project scope, objectives, and deliverables
Use resource planning to identify bottlenecks, unblock them, and adjust schedules accordingly

Proactively identify and mitigate risks to project delivery, and implement effective contingency plans when necessary
Coordinate with Operations Program Manager to ensure on-time delivery of all critical components
Coordinate design reviews to ensure all required deliverables meet high engineering standards, enabling a seamless transition from development to manufacturing

Lead end-to-end execution of complex robotics deployment programs—including scope definition, schedule development, budgeting, resource allocation, and stakeholder alignment—across multiple customer environments.

Interpret and evaluate complex architectural/AutoCAD drawings, electrical work instructions, network diagrams, and system specs to govern and validate physical system installations.

Direct Boston Dynamics Field Applications Engineering teams, third-party contractors, and vendors on-site. Oversee material logistics, site inventory management, critical-path tracking, and site safety compliance.

Partner with Field Engineering, Finance, and BizOps leadership to establish strategic program templates, delivery models, revenue milestone tracking, and scalable deployment methodologies.

Oversee logistics, strategy, and execution for high-profile customer pilot projects, field demonstrations, and trade show interactions.
Mentorship & Capability Building:
Mentor junior project team members and contribute to scaling organizational project and program management capabilities.

Execution:
Analyzes and prioritizes the varying aspects of the role, knows and/or follows the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, and consistently achieves results, even under tough circumstances.

Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives through effective communication that understands the unique needs of different audiences.
Innovation:
Creates new and better ways for the organization to be successful, anticipates and adopts innovations in business, operations, and technology applications.
Adaptability:
Adapts and pivots in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations, and moves forward productively and optimistically under conditions of change and ambiguity.

of progressive experience in technical project/program management, with direct leadership in fast-paced technology integration, robotics, or complex electromechanical system deployments.

High technical fluency across software/hardware integration, network architecture, controls, or industrial automation.
Expertise with enterprise configuration management, schedule tracking, and ticketing systems (Jira, Smartsheet, Salesforce, MS Project).
Strong track record of managing high-visibility, customer-facing technical projects in matrixed environments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Professional Project Management certification (PMP, Agile, or equivalent).
Deep project experience in autonomous mobile robots (AMR), unstructured robotic implementations, or structured inspection systems.
Mastery of testing, manufacturing, commissioning, and quality control processes in commercial/industrial environments.

title: Staff Technical Program Manager - AI Resources

fields.duties:
As a
Technical Program Manager
within Boston Dynamics PMO, you will be an integral part of the core program leadership, accountable for the operational efficiency of the resources that power our AI teams. You will own the sequencing and prioritization of work across our training clusters, data processing pipelines, and data operations teams, ensuring our engineers can move as fast as possible as we scale our AI robotics strategy.
The ideal candidate will have considerable influence over how AI infrastructure resources are allocated and will regularly engage with AI engineering leads and stakeholders to ensure successful outcomes. We're seeking a self-motivated individual capable of balancing strategic vision with meticulous attention to detail, essential for fostering consensus amidst competing demands for limited compute. A crucial skill you'll possess is the ability to discern dependencies across engineering, data, and infrastructure teams, adeptly navigating complex tradeoffs, and integrating them into a cohesive resourcing plan.
Boston Dynamics is a world leader in mobile robots, tackling some of the toughest robotics challenges. For years, our awe-inspiring viral videos on YouTube have shown the world what remarkably capable robots can do. Now we are quickly becoming a recognized leader in automation solutions for industrial applications and warehouse logistics.
How you will make an impact:
Organize, sequence, and prioritize work across our training clusters, data processing pipelines, data operations teams, and other engineering groups so the organization operates at maximum efficiency.
Allocate our substantial GPU resources across many concurrent model-training projects; work directly with teams to queue critical work, prioritize competing requests, and ensure teams maximize their output.
Oversee critical data processing pipelines that convert real-world robot experience into the data used to train and control AI models.
Manage relationships with external vendors who support data annotation and QA at scale.
Drive consistency, improvement, and efficiency by proactively scheduling resource utilization ahead of critical business events and deadlines.
Collaborate with AI engineering leadership to define resourcing objectives and priorities, and develop plans and roadmaps that keep infrastructure aligned with the broader AI robotics strategy.
Identify potential risks to compute or data availability that may impact program delivery; develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans to minimize disruption.
Engage with key stakeholders, including AI engineers, data operations leads, and executives, to provide updates on resource utilization, gather feedback, and address bottlenecks.
Drive process improvements and best practices for resource allocation and utilization tracking; conduct post-program reviews to identify areas for improvement.
Drive other program deliverables across AI infrastructure and the teams dedicated to building BD's internal AI tools and capabilities.
Manage data procurement and contract negotiations. Investigate and source commercial training data sets needed for future modeling.
What You bring:
BS or higher in Engineering or a Technical Related Field (Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, etc.) or equivalent work experience.
Minimum 2 years of experience in a program management role, managing multiple programs and schedules, ideally involving compute or infrastructure resourcing.
Passion for problem solving and a drive to ask questions and understand the big picture while still being attentive to technical details.
Strong communication skills and the ability to distill complex technical information into concise, easily understood formats: presentations, white papers, and status updates.
Proven capacity to leverage an array of project management tools, methodologies, and techniques throughout the AI/ML development lifecycle, including Google Suite, JIRA/Atlassian Products, and similar systems.
Ability to see, understand, and articulate team priorities in support of overall company and AI strategy goals.
Experience coordinating across engineering and data teams to manage shared, constrained resources (e.g., GPU/compute clusters, data pipelines).
Proven experience building sustainable processes within cross-functional groups.
Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills; ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
Nice to have:
Direct experience managing GPU or training cluster resource allocation.
Familiarity with data annotation/QA vendor management for ML pipelines.
Broad technical background and understanding of AI/ML model training workflows, ideally in a robotics context.
The base pay range for this position is between $130,000 to $150,000 annually. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience.
This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Boston Dynamics offers a generous Benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401(k), paid time off and an annual bonus structure.
Additional details regarding these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer for employment.

title: Principal Product Manager, Physical AI Applications (Retail & 3PL)

fields.duties:
About Dexterity
Dexterity is the enterprise Physical AI company building intelligent robots for complex industrial work.
Dexterity's Mech systems combine the Foresight World Model, robotics, and a Physical AI platform to perform demanding logistics workflows - including trailer loading, trailer unloading, and airport baggage handling - at the speed, reliability, and safety levels required for high-volume operations. Dexterity's Foresight World Model powers real-time perception, planning, and execution across physical environments with the interpretability required for industrial deployment. Dexterity is headquartered in Redwood City, California.
Dexterity is backed by world-class investors such as Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Obvious Ventures. We are a diverse and multidisciplinary team with a culture built on passion, trust, and dedication.
About the Role
Dexterity is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and commercialization of Physical AI applications for Retail and Third-party Logistics (3PL) sector. You'll own application product lines running on Dexterity's Mech platform, as well as the developer interfaces that enable solution partners to build new applications and integrations.
This role combines product ownership, outbound product management, and commercial leadership. You will define how Dexterity grows in Retail and 3PL through market segmentation, continuous discovery, and product and vertical-growth roadmaps. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, bringing product judgment into priority accounts and market evidence into product strategy.
You will own product strategy, roadmaps, PRDs, and specifications; drive application-level decisions with engineering; and prove the product on customer floors. You will set quantitative targets, validate them in the real world, and lead flagship deployments through KPI proof, signed acceptance, and expansion. You will determine which customer problems become repeatable products and turn reference solutions, market-entry plays, and deployment learning into scalable growth.
The role is scoped at Principal. Candidates demonstrating broader leadership and company-level vertical strategy may be considered at the Director level. Travel is approximately 25%.
Responsibilities
Product and Market Leadership
Own application and developer-interface product strategy, roadmaps, PRDs, and specifications for Retail and 3PL growth
Segment markets by customer, workflow, need, buying readiness, economics, and product fit to focus product and GTM investment
Lead outbound discovery with customers, prospects, operators, executives, integrators, and partners to uncover needs, buying barriers, willingness to pay, and differentiated value
Convert evidence into vertical-growth roadmaps across capabilities, integrations, proof points, reference solutions, and ecosystem needs; distinguish repeatable needs from one-offs and recommend build, partner, defer, or decline
Set entitlement, throughput, availability, reliability, adoption, and business-value targets and hold the product to dated proof gates
GTM Partnership and Commercialization
Partner with GTM on ideal customer profiles, priority segments and accounts, market-entry plays, competitive positioning, and the pipeline-to-roadmap loop
Join priority pursuits early to frame the operational problem, qualify product fit, lead product discovery, and keep commercial commitments grounded in product reality
Build reference solutions, concepts of operations, value propositions, and business cases covering volume, automation eligibility, labor, savings, and operational impact
Inform packaging and pricing with segment economics, willingness-to-pay evidence, competition, and delivery cost while the appropriate GTM owner retains final commercial authority
Equip GTM and partners with the narrative, proof, qualification criteria, and objection handling needed to sell credibly
Support expansion, new-logo pursuits, executive visits, and opportunity reactivation against the application portfolio's named revenue objective
Product Delivery and Customer Proof
Drive application-level decisions with engineering, including end effectors, multi-pick, architectures, and material-handling interfaces
Own systems testing against customer box populations and turn results into specification, roadmap, and commercial-readiness decisions
Lead deployments through shipment, first pick, go-live, KPI proof, acceptance, and expansion; direct field execution through playbooks, metrics, and defect escalation
Own contractual acceptance criteria, FAT/SAT/UAT evidence, disputed claims, and the signed record that unlocks the commercial outcome
Own the product relationship for developer-interface engagements and turn bespoke integrator delivery into a repeatable model
Run a written-first cadence across engineering, field issues, product/GTM reviews, executives, and customers using measured performance and market evidence
Qualifications Required
10+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, and/or management consulting, including ownership of an enterprise product line in robotics, industrial automation, physical products, or a similarly complex domain
Outbound product management success in segmentation, customer and prospect discovery, prioritization, and evidence-based growth roadmaps
Strong GTM partnership across account strategy, product qualification, market entry, competitive positioning, and commercial outcomes
Ownership of enterprise deployments from installation through KPI proof and contracted expansion - not only pilots
Experience setting quantitative targets and running systems tests that prove them
Experience in warehouse, parcel, or retail-distribution operations
Experience working with enterprise contracts, product acceptance criteria, customer validation processes (such as FAT/SAT/UAT), and integrator or partner delivery models.
Engineering partnership across end effectors, motion, perception, and material-handling integration
Experience creating specifications, reference solutions, value propositions, and ROI analyses that drive enterprise growth
Clear written communication through PRDs, strategy and market syntheses, status reports, and decision records
Ability to work regularly from our Redwood City headquarters and travel approximately 25% of the time to customer sites
Qualifications Preferred
Vertical strategy experience in enterprise technology, industrial automation, robotics, or material handling
Success scaling bespoke integration into repeatable offerings across customers or segments
Experience with pricing and packaging inputs, competition, partner strategy, or portfolio economics
Industrial-robotics safety literacy and startup or scale-up experience
What Makes You Successful
Move comfortably between the market, customer floor, roadmap, and executive room
Treat GTM as a product partner, sharing evidence and growth accountability
Find scalable segment patterns behind individual requests
Balance customer pull, commercial value, repeatability, and technical feasibility
Prove products with data and communicate decisions through closure
Build credibility with engineers, field teams, customer and sales executives, and integrators
Compensation
The annual base salary range for this position is $180,000–$225,000 USD. Dexterity's total rewards may also include equity and medical, dental, and vision benefits. Actual compensation is determined based on experience, skills, scope, level, qualifications, and internal equity.
 


Equal Opportunity Employer
Dexterity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with fairness and respect.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
Dexterity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and applicants requiring accommodations during the hiring process, consistent with applicable law.   If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know.

Senior Manager, Site Operations
Location: Hagerstown, MD (Onsite)
 
Ideally based in the Hagerstown / Western Maryland region, or within practical commuting proximity such as Frederick, MD; Martinsburg, WV; Chambersburg / Greencastle, PA; Winchester, VA; or the broader DC / Baltimore outer corridor, with willingness to be onsite daily during deployment, commissioning, and handoff periods.
 
About Dexterity
 
At Dexterity, we believe robots can positively transform the world. Our breakthrough technology frees people to do the creative, inspiring, problem-solving jobs that humans do best by enabling robots to handle repetitive and physically difficult work.
 
We’re starting with warehouse automation, where the need for smarter, more resilient supply chains impacts millions of lives and businesses around the world. Dexterity's full-stack robotics systems pick, move, pack, and collaborate with human-like skill, awareness, and learning capabilities. Our systems are software-driven and hardware-agnostic and have already picked over 15 million goods in production. And did we mention we’re customer-obsessed?  Every decision, large and small, is driven by one question – how can we empower our customers with robots to do more than they thought was possible?
 
Dexterity is one of the fastest-growing companies in robotics, backed by world-class investors such as Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Obvious Ventures. We’re a diverse and multidisciplinary team with a culture built on passion, trust, and dedication.  Come join Dexterity and help make intelligent robots a reality!


The Role 
Dexterity is seeking a Senior Manager, Site Operations to lead onsite deployment execution for a major customer program in the Hagerstown, Maryland area.
This role serves as the operational leader responsible for coordinating site readiness, installation, commissioning, training, operational handoff, and customer adoption. You will work across Customer Success, Product, Field Engineering, Field Services, Support, Commercial, and customer operations teams to ensure successful deployment and long-term operational success.
Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, disciplined execution, customer-facing leadership, and the ability to translate complex deployment plans into measurable operational outcomes.
This is a highly visible role where your decisions will directly influence deployment quality, customer trust, operational readiness, and Dexterity's ability to scale Physical AI systems in production environments.
Responsibilities
Maintain an integrated execution plan across site readiness, installation, commissioning, training, support readiness, and operational handoff activities.
Lead day-to-day coordination with systems integrators, subcontractors, vendors, customer stakeholders, and internal Dexterity teams.
Drive execution accountability through structured tracking of owners, milestones, blockers, risks, and escalations.
Review technical documentation including Statements of Work (SOWs), engineering drawings, requirements documents, responsibility matrices, commissioning plans, safety documentation, and acceptance criteria.
Audit field execution against approved technical requirements and project scope.
Manage deployment punch lists and drive closure through documented evidence and verification.
Validate completion evidence including commissioning reports, inspection records, test results, training completion records, customer signoffs, and acceptance documentation.
Identify and resolve gaps between reported completion status and actual operational readiness.
Track schedule performance, critical-path dependencies, scope risks, and deployment readiness metrics.
Escalate issues proactively with clear recommendations and recovery plans.
Partner with customer operations leaders to support decisions involving workflow design, staffing, throughput objectives, operating windows, and system utilization.
Capture deployment lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement of Dexterity deployment methodologies and playbooks.
Qualifications
Required
10+ years of experience leading complex technical deployments involving robotics, industrial automation, warehouse automation, material handling systems, infrastructure programs, or related environments.
Experience operating at a Senior Manager, Site Execution Lead, Technical Program Manager, Deployment Manager, Operations Manager, or similar leadership level.
Strong technical literacy across robotics, automation, controls, electrical and mechanical systems, industrial equipment, or comparable technologies.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, commissioning plans, acceptance criteria, and project documentation.
Experience managing vendors, systems integrators, contractors, field service providers, and installation teams.
Proven ability to assess technical readiness and operational readiness independently.
Strong project execution, risk management, and escalation management skills.
Excellent communication skills with technical teams, customer stakeholders, site leadership, and executive audiences.
Demonstrated ability to balance operational objectives, customer needs, safety requirements, and deployment timelines.
Willingness to be onsite regularly throughout deployment, commissioning, and stabilization activities.
Preferred
Experience in parcel, logistics, fulfillment, warehouse, distribution center, or high-throughput industrial environments.
Prior responsibility for day-to-day operational performance in warehouse or industrial settings.
Experience with robotics systems, PLCs, industrial controls, safety systems, MHE, WMS/WES integrations, commissioning, or site acceptance testing.
PMP, Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Construction Management, or related certifications.
Experience supporting go-live readiness, customer acceptance testing, hypercare, or operational stabilization programs.
What Makes You Successful
Strong execution discipline and accountability.
Excellent technical judgment and attention to detail.
Credibility with both operational and technical stakeholders.
Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive decisions.
Customer-first mindset with a focus on operational outcomes.
Structured communication and proactive escalation practices.
Bias toward action, ownership, and closure

Compensation
Base pay is one component of Dexterity's total rewards package, which may also include equity, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, and other compensation elements depending on eligibility.
The annual base salary range for this position is
$180,000–$210,000 USD
. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, education, and overall qualifications.
Final compensation will be determined on a case-by-case basis and will also consider relevant experience and internal equity.

Equal Opportunity Employer
 
Dexterity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
